summary: Atlantic tarpon is a large, silvery coastal fish known for powerful leaps when hooked. It tolerates a wide range of salinities, and juveniles may enter freshwater. Tarpon can gulp air at the surface; Florida manages it principally as a catch-and-release sport fish.

features: Last dorsal-fin ray forms a long trailing filament

habitat.description: Adults mainly use inshore coastal water and spawn offshore; juveniles also enter freshwater.

eating: Tarpon has little food value and is mainly pursued for catch-and-release fishing in Florida.
